hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; base=$(basename "$f"); case "$base" in .env.example) ;; .env|.env.*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing an env file that likely holds live secrets (SECRET_KEY, Openpay keys, Cloudinary, Brevo). Confirm this edit is intentional."}}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in comercial/views_openpay.py|*/comercial/views_openpay.py|comercial/services_openpay.py|*/comercial/services_openpay.py) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This file handles live Openpay payments/webhooks (checkout, charge confirmation, idempotency). Confirm this change before it ships."}}' ;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; } || true

hooks.statusMessage: Running the touched app's Django tests...
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in comercial/migrations/*|*/comercial/migrations/*|contabilidad/migrations/*|*/contabilidad/migrations/*|airbnb/migrations/*|*/airbnb/migrations/*|facturacion/migrations/*|*/facturacion/migrations/*|nomina/migrations/*|*/nomina/migrations/*) app="" ;; comercial/*.py|*/comercial/*.py) app="comercial" ;; contabilidad/*.py|*/contabilidad/*.py) app="contabilidad" ;; airbnb/*.py|*/airbnb/*.py) app="airbnb" ;; facturacion/*.py|*/facturacion/*.py) app="facturacion" ;; nomina/*.py|*/nomina/*.py) app="nomina" ;; *) app="" ;; esac; if [ -n "$app" ]; then cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && python manage.py test "$app" --failfast 2>&1 | tail -30; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; base=$(basename "$f"); case "$base" in models.py) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; out=$(python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then msg=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -10 | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/"/\\"/g'); printf '{"systemMessage":"makemigrations --check found unmigrated model changes: %s"}' "$msg"; fi ;; esac; } || true
